messages:
Jonah (CS): Quick draft runbook idea for customers that show bursty traffic + streaming latency spikes. Wanted to capture a short, customer-facing checklist we can hand to PMs for go-live and a few troubleshooting steps. PTAL :wave:

Diego (CSE): love it. keep it short and prescriptive. can you call out a fallback policy for heavy tails? :thinking_face:

Jonah (CS): yep — thinking a 3-tier fallback: 1) prefilling + small fixed-batch on warmups, 2) switch to short-response non-streaming during surge, 3) degrade to cheaper model variant. I'll add concrete config snippets below.

Sarah (CSM): add a renewal-risk note: if customer sees >2x latency during onboarding and their SLA tier is high, flag renewal risk to AM within 24h. small wording tweak: "who to ping" and contact template.

Diego (CSE): config snippets: use this as copy-paste in the docs (we run this as a recommended default):

```yaml
prefill:
  enabled: true
  ttl: 10m  # keep prefixes for 10 minutes
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 512
  max_wait_ms: 30
streaming_policy:
  prefer_stream: true
  fallback_to_sync_after_ms: 400  # if streaming hasn't returned a token by 400ms, fall back
fallback_order:
  - short_response_variant
  - cheaper_quantized_variant
```

Jonah (CS): nice. also add this quick troubleshooting flow so CS can triage before escalating:
- check: token breakdown in console (are most tokens spent in decode or prefill?)
- if prefill heavy -> reduce prefill size or lower TTL to 2m
- if decode heavy -> try quantized variant + increase batch size by 1.

OpsBot: deploy status: prefilling-config v2 rolled to staging 03:04 UTC, no errors. :white_check_mark:

Sarah (CSM): short customer-facing checklist we can DM to the AM/PM on first day: 1) run the quick health check (link to dashboard) 2) enable prefill TTL=10m if cold starts >5s 3) set fallback policy to non-stream after 400ms 4) capture "latency spike" in renewal notes template. I can draft the DM.

Diego (CSE): one more suggestion: add a tiny eval prompt set to detect hallucinations when switching variants. If quality drops after fallback, the AM should know to roll back. Example check: run 5 golden prompts, expect >= 90% pass.

Jonah (CS): awesome — I'll stitch these into a 1-pager and a short DM template for AMs. Action: Jonah to publish doc + Sarah to draft AM DM by EOD. If anyone wants edits, reply here. :thumbsup:

Sarah (CSM): I'll also add a short telemetry capture note (what to screenshot): token timeline + 95th p50/p95 latency and the model/variant used. keeps the ticket triage fast.

Diego (CSE): LGTM. I'm available for a quick 15m to review the 1-pager after you draft it.

Jonah (CS): Thanks team — will post the doc link here when ready.
